text:
ravi (product): Quick alignment: hedged-capacity lanes for GA. We need a crisp GA criteria doc covering SLA wording, billing behavior, monitoring panels, runbook handoff, and CS playbook. Prefer owners + final wording by Friday.

hank (eng): I can draft the SLA wording about availability and an internal perf SLO. Proposal: public availability 99.95% for GA control plane; pilot stays at 99.9%. Internal perf SLO: p99 < 380ms across standard routes. Thoughts?

tess (sre): Pager thresholds: p99 > 550ms for 5m OR error rate > 2% for 5m -> page. Also want synthetic canary checks for each region and an "overflow rate" metric. I'll own runbook + dashboards.

marie (legal): Legal request: do not promise quality guarantees if fallback to lower-fidelity model is used. Need explicit SLA carve-out language. Also confirm whether payout/liability applies to capacity-tier failures.

leah (finance): Billing stance: GA should offer a per-token base rate + optional capacity-hedge fee (monthly commit) or usage surcharge (on-demand). We need clear UI wording and invoice examples. For hedged customers we commit capacity and give a discounted per-token rate.

david (cs): CS asks: provide a short script for conversations and an FAQ item about "what happens during a capacity event". Also need a way to show affected customers immediately in Console.

ravi (product): Proposed public SLA sentence: "Redwood Inference guarantees 99.95% availability of the routing control plane. In exceptional load events we may route requests to alternative model variants to preserve availability; such measures are excluded from any latency guarantees." Tag legal for review.

hank (eng): Agree with carve-out language. Technical note: fallback to quantized or trimmed variants may change output; we'll surface that in docs and in the Console toggle description. Config snippet for ops repo: ```yaml
capacity_hedge:
  default_opt_in: false
  hedge_commit_monthly: 0
  surge_multiplier: 1.4
```

marie (legal): Wording tweak: replace "excluded from any latency guarantees" with "not covered by latency SLOs or financial remedies". That clarifies liability.

leah (finance): For invoicing examples: please include both monthly commit sample and on-demand surcharge. Example line: "Capacity Hedge (monthly commit) 100k tokens @ $0.0008/token" and "Surge Surcharge (on-demand) 1.4x tokens routed during surge windows". I'll review docs wording.

tess (sre): Monitoring panels to build: availability-by-region, p99-by-route, fallback-engagement-rate, hedged-commit-usage, billing-estimate-sim. Will open dashboard PR.

david (cs): CS template ask: short message, explain that routing preserved availability, offer to disable hedging, include billing preview link and expected ETA for resolution. I'll draft.

deploy-bot: Ticket created: GA-hedge-runbook-2026 (assigned to tess).

ravi (product): Owners recap: SLA language & public copy -> hank + marie review; runbook & alerts -> tess; billing examples & UI copy -> leah; CS templates & FAQ -> david; docs page -> hank + david + leah. Drafts due Thursday EOD, legal signoff Friday morning.

hank (eng): One more ask: confirm default state for GA: hedging OFF by default; customers may opt into monthly commit or opt-in to surge surcharge. That affects telemetry tagging.

leah (finance): Confirm default OFF. We will surface a "Estimated monthly delta" modal before enabling. Also need a CSV export for billing reconciliation.

marie (legal): I'll review the final SLA and the "not covered" clause. Also request a short appendix outlining customer remedies if availability breaches occur (simple credit formula).

tess (sre): I'll add alert playbooks for both hedged and non-hedged customers and a quick mitigation path: scale-up path -> throttle -> fallback -> notify -> rollback.

david (cs): I'll sync with the pilot customers to prepare messaging. Also want a Console flag to mark a customer as "hedged" for easy filter.

ravi (product): Solid. Action items list: hank -> draft SLA + docs copy; tess -> runbook + dashboards + PR; leah -> billing examples + UI modal copy; david -> CS templates + Console filter request; marie -> legal review + credit formula. Check-in Friday 10:00 PT. Any objections?

hank (eng): No objections. Will post initial draft by tomorrow noon.

(ended thread)
